Name: river_road_place
name: The River Road
description: The raised earth road that follows the river bank north-east out of the fields; carts, donkeys and the caravans from the north come this way.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §5 (the City of the Moon: hub of trade); mechanics.md row 31 (transport); notes L52

Name: riverbank_reeds_place
name: The Reed Banks
description: Tall reed beds along the river where the fishermen beach their reed boats and cut reeds for mats; lions have been heard in the reeds at dusk.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §3 (the two waters; boats); mechanics.md row 31 (boats); notes L57

Name: canal_head_place
name: The Canal Head
description: The sluice where the great irrigation canal leaves the river; the barley plots beyond it depend on its gate being opened in the drought.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §3 (farmers harvesting wheat and barley); wb §4.1 (the drought that is breaking the world); notes L57;L15

Name: date_grove_place
name: The Date Grove
description: Walled date palms and the shade-gardens beneath them, owned by households of the street; pickers climb the palms in the vintage.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); foods.csv dates; seasons.csv vintage

Name: northern_ford_place
name: The Northern Ford
description: Where the river runs shallow enough to wade in the dry months; herders and smugglers cross here away from the gate's count.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.1 (the drought); mechanics.md row 36 (journeys)

Name: tell_ruins_place
name: The Tell of the Old Town
description: A grassed-over mound of an older town, its mudbrick walls slumped into hummocks; broken rooms under the crest give shelter to whoever does not want to be found.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); regions.csv south plan 2 (remains of old communities; abandoned towns); wb §7; notes L143

Name: southern_marsh_place
name: The Southern Marsh
description: The edge of the swamps: channels between reed walls, buffalo wallows and fowlers' platforms. The sage of the swamps is said to have walked here.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.2 (the mysterious sage of the swamps); regions.csv west plan 1 (swamps/wetlands); notes L19

Name: reed_islands_place
name: The Reed Islands
description: Floating islands of cut reed deep in the marsh, reachable only by boat or by those who know the paths; a place for runaways and debtors to vanish.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.2; mechanics.md row 12 (outlawry: stateless outside any city's protection)

Name: old_tombs_place
name: The Old Graves
description: The old burial ground beyond the wall: shaft graves of forgotten households and a few great tombs of the city's first rulers, robbed more than once.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); A: the Royal Cemetery of Ur (Woolley's excavations) lies beside the city of Ur; D-018 (City of the Moon = Ur); events.csv royal_tomb_violated

Name: desert_edge_place
name: The Desert Edge
description: Where the last irrigated plot gives up to gravel and sand; the wind off the south carries grit and the smell of nothing.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); regions.csv south (endless desert; only death reigns here); wb §7; notes L136-143

Name: desert_caverns_place
name: The Rocky Caverns
description: A low scarp of rotten rock riddled with caverns; cool by day and dark by night, the dens of jackals and of men who live by what passes on the road.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); regions.csv south plan 1 (rocky caverns); wb §7; notes L137

Name: suti_wells_place
name: The Sutean Wells
description: Three brackish wells at the map's southern rim, the last water before the open desert; the Suti water their animals here when they come north.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); factions.csv suti (reign alone in the South); regions.csv south plan 2; notes L143; A: the Suteans, steppe nomads of the Old Babylonian texts

Name: eastern_road_place
name: The Eastern Road
description: The road east toward the mountains, rutted by carts and scattered with the leavings of those fleeing west.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.1 (foreigners from the east raid and migrate into the Empire); wb §4.3; notes L15;L20-21

Name: eastern_waystation_place
name: The Eastern Waystation
description: A walled caravan halt at the map's eastern rim, half its rooms empty since the raids began; beyond it the road runs on toward the mountains.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); wb §4.3 (the Barbarians: new lands in the west); cities.csv city_of_the_warrior_spirit; mechanics.md row 36 (journeys)

Name: shrine_ruins_place
name: The Broken Shrine
description: A roadside shrine to a forgotten god, its roof fallen in; ash in the old offering pit says someone camps here again.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-021 wild lands); regions.csv south plan 2 (the War Age's claw marks: abandoned towns); wb §1;§7; notes L143
